UsageInsights.text_a11b1413d7: Statistics use UTC calendar days. The last 7 or 30 days include today. New input, cache reads, cache writes and output are counted separately; reasoning output is not counted twice.
UsageInsights.text_b902a0c87c: Streaming Codex snapshots for the same request are merged under the date of the last usage change. Quota-only updates do not change that date.
